en.s: The Battle of Fei River, also known as the Battle of Feishui (simplified Chinese: 淝水之战; traditional Chinese: 淝水之戰; pinyin: Féishǔi zhī zhàn), took place in the autumn of 383 AD in China, where forces of the Di-led Former Qin dynasty were decisively defeated by the outnumbered army of the Eastern Jin dynasty. The location of the battle, the Fei River, no longer exists but is believed to have flowed through modern Lu'an, Anhui, near the Huai River.

zh.s: 淝水之战（又称淝水战役）发生于383年秋。氐族建立的前秦军队在中国被人数较少的东晋军队击败。淝水如今已不复存在，据信曾流经今安徽六安附近、淮河一带。

en.t: Franco-German war of 978–980: Holy Roman Emperor Otto II lifts the siege of Paris and withdraws
en.s: The Franco-German war of 978–980 was fought over possession of Lotharingia and over personal honour. In the summer of 978, King Lothair of West Francia (France) launched a surprise attack on Aachen, almost capturing the Emperor Otto II, king of East Francia (Germany) and of Italy. By autumn Lothair had returned to West Francia, while Otto had convoked a diet and assembled an army.

zh.t: 978—980年法兰克—德意志战争：神圣罗马帝国皇帝奥托二世解除巴黎之围并撤军
zh.s: 978—980年的法兰克—德意志战争围绕洛塔林吉亚的归属和个人荣誉而起。978年夏，西法兰克国王洛泰尔突然袭击亚琛，险些俘获奥托二世。奥托二世是东法兰克（德国）和意大利的国王，也是皇帝。到了秋天，洛泰尔已返回西法兰克，奥托则召集帝国议会并集结军队。

en.s: The Battle of Culblean was fought on 30 November 1335, during the Second War of Scottish Independence. It was a victory for the Scots led by the Guardian, Sir Andrew Murray over an Anglo-Scots force commanded by David III Strathbogie, titular Earl of Atholl, and a leading supporter of Edward Balliol.

zh.s: 1335年11月30日，苏格兰第二次独立战争期间，安德鲁·默里爵士率领的苏格兰军队击败了英格兰—苏格兰联军。对方由名义上的阿瑟尔伯爵、爱德华·巴利奥尔的主要支持者大卫三世·斯特拉思博吉指挥。

en.s: The Battle of Murafa or the Battle of Kopystrzyń was a battle that consisted of two clashes between the Polish army and the forces of Podolian starosta Fedir Nesvizhsky who supported the Lithuanian prince Švitrigaila, during the Lithuanian civil war of 1432–1438. According to most sources, the Ruthenian army humiliated the Polish unit, which was crossing the Murafa River, in the first clash, however in the second clash the Podolians were defeated.

zh.s: 穆拉法之战又称科皮斯特林之战，由两次交战组成，发生在1432—1438年立陶宛内战期间。波兰军队与支持立陶宛王公什维特里盖拉的波多利亚地方长官费迪尔·涅兹维日斯基所部交战。据多数资料记载，第一次交战中，罗斯军队击败了正在渡过穆拉法河的波兰部队；第二次交战中，波多利亚军队落败。

en.s: The Battle of Millarapue that occurred November 30, 1557 was intended by the Toqui Caupolicán as a Mapuche ambush of the Spanish army of García Hurtado de Mendoza that resulted in a Spanish victory when the ambush failed.

zh.s: 1557年11月30日，托基·考波利坎计划在米拉拉普埃伏击加西亚·乌尔塔多·德·门多萨率领的西班牙军队，但伏击失败，西班牙军获胜。

en.s: The naval Battle of Dungeness took place on 30 November 1652 (10 December in the Gregorian calendar) during the First Anglo-Dutch War near the cape of Dungeness in Kent.

zh.s: 第一次英荷战争期间，1652年11月30日（格里历12月10日），邓杰内斯海战在英国肯特郡邓杰内斯角附近海域打响。

en.s: The Battle of Narva on 30 November 1700 was an early battle in the Great Northern War. A Swedish relief army under Charles XII of Sweden defeated a Russian siege force three to four times its size. Previously, Charles XII had forced Denmark–Norway to sign the Treaty of Travendal. Narva was not followed by further advances of the Swedish army into Russia; instead, Charles XII turned southward to expel August the Strong from Livonia and Poland–Lithuania.

zh.s: 1700年11月30日，大北方战争初期，瑞典救援军在瑞典国王卡尔十二世率领下击败了人数为瑞军三至四倍的俄罗斯围城部队。此前，卡尔十二世迫使丹麦—挪威签署《特拉文达尔条约》。此后，瑞军没有继续进军俄罗斯，卡尔十二世转而向南，驱逐强者奥古斯特在利沃尼亚和波兰立陶宛联邦的势力。

en.t: The second 1707 siege of Pensacola ends
en.s: The second siege of Pensacola ended on November 30, 1707, after Creek attackers supported by English colonists failed to take the Spanish fort. The attackers had assaulted the settlement from November 28, and one of their leading chiefs was killed during the night of November 29–30. They lifted the siege the following morning. An earlier attack on Pensacola that August was a separate siege; the November fighting ended without the fort's capture.
en.n: November 30 was the end of the second siege, which ran November 28–30; the first siege occurred in August.

zh.t: 1707年第二次彭萨科拉围攻结束
zh.s: 1707年11月30日，克里克人武装在英属殖民地人员支持下，对西班牙控制的彭萨科拉发动的第二次围攻结束。进攻从11月28日持续到30日，但未能攻下西班牙堡垒。进攻方一名首领在29日至30日夜间死亡，其部队随后撤走。同年8月这里还发生过另一次围攻，两次战事不能混为一谈。
zh.n: 11月30日是第二次围攻的结束日；这次围攻从11月28日持续到30日。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Virginia on November 30, 1781. The delegate from Charles City County Benjamin Harrison V defeated the former delegate to the Second Continental Congress Richard Henry Lee and the delegate from Gloucester County John Page. Thomas Nelson Jr. was elected by the Virginia General Assembly to succeed the retiring governor of Virginia Thomas Jefferson on June 12, 1781.

zh.s: 1781年11月30日，弗吉尼亚州举行州长选举。查尔斯城县代表本杰明·哈里森五世击败了第二届大陆会议前代表理查德·亨利·李和格洛斯特县代表约翰·佩奇。托马斯·纳尔逊于1781年6月12日由弗吉尼亚州议会选为州长，接替即将卸任的托马斯·杰斐逊。

en.s: The Battle of Kedges Strait (also known as the Battle of the Barges) took place on November 30, 1782 near Tangier Sound in the Chesapeake Bay near the town of Onancock, Virginia, between naval militia forces of the rebellious British colony of Maryland and the Royal Navy of Great Britain.

zh.s: 1782年11月30日，叛乱的英国殖民地马里兰州海上民兵与英国皇家海军在弗吉尼亚州坦吉尔湾附近的凯奇斯海峡交战，地点靠近昂纳科克镇。此战又称驳船之战。

en.t: Britain and the United States sign preliminary peace articles in Paris
en.s: On November 30, 1782, British and American representatives signed preliminary peace articles in Paris during negotiations to end the American Revolutionary War. The agreement set out terms including recognition of United States independence, but it was conditional on a wider peace with France. The definitive Treaty of Paris followed on September 3, 1783.
en.n: This is the preliminary agreement of 1782, not the definitive Treaty of Paris signed in 1783.

zh.t: 英国与美国代表在巴黎签署初步和平条款
zh.s: 1782年11月30日，英国和美国代表在巴黎签署初步和平条款，商定承认美国独立等结束独立战争的条件。不过，条款要等英国与法国达成相应和约后才能生效。正式的《巴黎条约》直到1783年9月3日才签署。
zh.n: 此条是1782年的初步协议，不是1783年签署的正式《巴黎条约》。

en.s: The 1786 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 30, 1786, in order to elect the Governor of Maryland. Incumbent Governor William Smallwood was easily re-elected by the Maryland General Assembly as he ran unopposed. The exact results of this election are unknown.

zh.s: 1786年11月30日，马里兰州举行州长选举。现任州长威廉·斯莫尔伍德没有对手，由州议会轻松连任。具体选举结果不详。

en.s: The Battle of Kaiserslautern (28–30 November 1793) saw a Coalition army under Charles William Ferdinand, Duke of Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel oppose a Republican French army led by Lazare Hoche. Three days of conflict resulted in a victory by the Prussians and their Electoral Saxon allies as they turned back repeated French attacks.

zh.s: 1793年11月28日至30日，布伦瑞克-沃尔芬比特尔公爵卡尔·威廉·斐迪南率领的反法同盟军与拉扎尔·奥什指挥的法国共和军交战。三天激战后，普鲁士军及其萨克森盟友击退了法国军队一轮又一轮的进攻，取得胜利。

en.s: The Balmis Expedition (1803–1806) was a three-year mission to the Americas led by Dr. Francisco Javier de Balmis with the aim of vaccinating millions against smallpox. Vaccination, a much safer way to prevent smallpox than older methods such as inoculation, had been introduced by the English physician Edward Jenner in 1798. The Balmis expedition set off from A Coruña on 30 November 1803. It may be considered the first international health-care expedition in history. The discoverer of the vaccine, Edward Jenner himself, wrote, "I don’t imagine the annals of history furnish an example of philanthropy so noble, so extensive as this."

zh.s: 巴尔米斯远征（1803—1806年）是弗朗西斯科·哈维尔·德·巴尔米斯医生率领的一次为期三年的美洲任务，旨在为数百万人接种天花疫苗。接种疫苗比旧式人痘接种等方法更安全；英国医生爱德华·詹纳于1798年引入了这种预防天花的方法。巴尔米斯远征队于1803年11月30日从拉科鲁尼亚启程。它被视为历史上首次国际医疗远征。疫苗发现者詹纳本人写道：“我不认为史册中有哪件事能与此等高尚而广泛的慈善事业相比。”

en.s: French and Spanish forces invaded Portugal from 19–30 November 1807 during the Napoleonic Wars, sparking the Peninsular War. The Franco-Spanish invasion force was led by General Jean-Andoche Junot, while the Portuguese were under the nominal command of Prince Regent John, the future King John VI of Portugal. French and Spanish troops swiftly occupied the country in the face of little resistance due to the poor state of the Portuguese military.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 拿破仑战争期间，法国和西班牙军队于1807年11月19日至30日入侵葡萄牙，引发半岛战争。法西联军由让-安多什·朱诺将军率领，葡萄牙军名义上由摄政王若昂指挥，他后来成为葡萄牙国王若昂六世。葡萄牙军队状况不佳，法西军队仅遇到有限抵抗便迅速占领全国。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的入侵结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Somosierra occurred November 30, 1808, in the Peninsular War, when a French army under Napoleon I forced a passage through the Sierra de Guadarrama shielding Madrid. At the Somosierra mountain pass, 60 miles north of Madrid, a heavily outnumbered Spanish detachment of conscripts and artillery under Benito de San Juan aimed to block Napoleon's advance on the Spanish capital. Napoleon overwhelmed the Spanish positions in a combined arms attack, sending the Polish Chevau-légers of the Imperial Guard at the Spanish guns while French infantry advanced up the slopes. The victory removed the last obstacle barring the road to Madrid, which fell several days later.

zh.s: 1808年11月30日，半岛战争期间，拿破仑一世率领法军在索莫谢拉击败西班牙军队，打通了穿越瓜达拉马山脉、通往马德里的道路。索莫谢拉山口位于马德里以北约60英里处。贝尼托·德·圣胡安率领人数远少于法军的西班牙征召兵和炮兵，试图阻止拿破仑进军首都。拿破仑以步炮协同方式突破西班牙阵地：法军步兵沿山坡推进，帝国卫队波兰枪骑兵冲向西班牙炮兵阵地。几天后马德里陷落。

en.s: The 1809 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 30, 1809, in order to elect the governor of North Carolina. Incumbent Democratic-Republican governor David Stone was re-elected by the North Carolina General Assembly as he ran unopposed. The exact number of votes cast in this election is unknown.

zh.s: 1809年11月30日，北卡罗来纳州举行州长选举。民主共和党籍现任州长戴维·斯通没有对手，由州议会连任。具体票数不详。

en.s: The Battle of Arnhem (30 November 1813) saw Friedrich Wilhelm Freiherr von Bülow's Prussian corps fight an Imperial French division under Henri François Marie Charpentier at Arnhem. Attacking under the cover of fog, the Prussians broke into the city at several points and forced the French to retreat to Nijmegen after hard fighting in this War of the Sixth Coalition clash. Arnhem is a city in the Netherlands located on the Rhine River 100 kilometres (62 mi) southeast of Amsterdam. In late November 1813, Bülow's III Prussian Corps invaded the Netherlands, sparking a Dutch rebellion against the French.

zh.s: 1813年11月30日，弗里德里希·威廉·冯·比洛男爵率领的普鲁士军团与亨利·弗朗索瓦·玛丽·夏庞捷指挥的法军师在阿纳姆交战。普军借助浓雾掩护，从多个地点攻入城中。激战后，法军撤往奈梅亨。这是第六次反法同盟战争期间的一场战斗。阿纳姆是荷兰的一座城市，位于莱茵河畔，距阿姆斯特丹东南约100公里。1813年11月下旬，比洛的普鲁士第三军团入侵荷兰，引发荷兰人反抗法国统治。

en.s: The Battle of Nalapani was the first battle of the Anglo-Nepalese War of 1814–1816, fought between the forces of the British East India Company and Nepal, then ruled by the House of Gorkha. The battle took place around the Nalapani fort, near Dehradun, which was placed under siege by the British between 31 October and 30 November 1814. The fort's garrison was commanded by Captain Balbhadra Kunwar, while Major-General Rollo Gillespie, who had previously fought in the Battle of Java, was in charge of the attacking British troops.

zh.s: 纳拉帕尼之战是1814—1816年英尼战争的第一场战役，交战双方是英国东印度公司军队和尼泊尔军队。当时尼泊尔由廓尔喀王朝统治。1814年10月31日至11月30日，英军围攻德拉敦附近的纳拉帕尼堡。守军由巴尔巴德拉·昆瓦尔上尉指挥，进攻部队由曾参加爪哇战役的罗洛·吉莱斯皮少将率领。

en.s: The second siege of Missolonghi was the second attempt by Ottoman forces to capture the strategically located port town of Missolonghi during the third year of the Greek War of Independence (1823). The second siege is usually ignored however, and the name is often applied to the greater siege of 1825–1826.

zh.t: 第二次梅索隆吉围城战
zh.s: 第二次梅索隆吉围城战是奥斯曼军队第二次尝试夺取这座战略位置重要的港口城镇，发生在希腊独立战争第三年（1823年）。这次围城常被忽略，人们也常把“梅索隆吉围城战”一名用于指1825至1826年的大围城战。

en.s: The 1830 Liverpool by-election took place on 30 November to elect one of Liverpool's two Members of Parliament (MPs) after the death of incumbent William Huskisson. Huskisson, who had died in a railway accident in September, was a Tory, as was fellow MP Isaac Gascoyne. Radical William Ewart defeated Whig Evelyn Denison. Both men's views were regarded as similar, but Denison was considered more elitist and anti-reform.

zh.s: 1830年11月30日，利物浦举行补选，选出两名下议院议员中的一人。现任议员威廉·赫斯基森于9月在铁路事故中去世，导致该席位空缺。他是托利党议员，另一名议员艾萨克·加斯科因也属托利党。激进派候选人威廉·尤尔特击败辉格党候选人伊夫林·丹尼森。两人观点相近，但丹尼森被认为更精英主义、反改革。

en.s: The Sitgreaves Expedition Down the Zuni and Colorado Rivers in 1851 was a combined American scientific and military mission to explore the Zuni River, the Little Colorado River and the Colorado River in 1851. Setting out from northern New Mexico, the expedition traveled west across Arizona and then south along the Colorado to Fort Yuma in California.

zh.s: 1851年，西特格里夫斯沿祖尼河、小科罗拉多河和科罗拉多河开展远征，这是一项结合科学考察与军事任务的行动。远征队从新墨西哥北部出发，向西穿越亚利桑那州，再沿科罗拉多河向南前往加利福尼亚州的尤马堡。

en.s: The Battle of Sinop, or the Battle of Sinope, was a naval battle that took place on 30 November 1853 between Imperial Russia and the Ottoman Empire during the opening phase of the Crimean War (1853–1856). It took place at Sinop, a sea port on the southern shore of the Black Sea (the northern shore of Anatolian Turkey).

zh.s: 1853年11月30日，克里米亚战争（1853—1856年）初期，俄罗斯帝国与奥斯曼帝国在锡诺普交战。战场位于土耳其安纳托利亚南岸的海港城市锡诺普附近。

en.s: The Capture of Morelia took place on 30 November 1863 during the French intervention in Mexico. It was fought between French troops in charge of generals Berthier and Márquez and Mexican army commanded by José López Uraga.

zh.s: 1863年11月30日，法国干涉墨西哥期间，贝尔蒂耶将军和马尔克斯将军率领的法军与何塞·洛佩斯·乌拉加指挥的墨西哥军队在莫雷利亚交战。

en.s: The Battle of Franklin was fought on November 30, 1864, in Franklin, Tennessee, as part of the Franklin–Nashville Campaign of the American Civil War. It was one of the worst disasters of the war for the Confederate States Army. Confederate Lieutenant General John Bell Hood's Army of Tennessee conducted numerous frontal assaults against fortified positions occupied by the Union forces under Major General John Schofield and was unable to prevent Schofield from executing a planned, orderly withdrawal to Nashville.

zh.s: 1864年11月30日，美国内战期间，田纳西州富兰克林发生富兰克林之战，属于富兰克林—纳什维尔战役的一部分。这是邦联军在战争中遭遇的最惨重灾难之一。约翰·贝尔·胡德中将率领田纳西军团，多次正面进攻约翰·斯科菲尔德少将率领的联邦军坚固阵地，仍未能阻止斯科菲尔德按计划有序撤往纳什维尔。

en.s: The Battle of Honey Hill was the third battle of Savannah campaign, fought November 30, 1864, during the American Civil War. It did not involve Major General William T. Sherman's main force, marching from Atlanta to Savannah, Georgia, but was a failed Union Army expedition under Brig. Gen. John P. Hatch that attempted to cut off the Charleston and Savannah Railroad in support of Sherman's projected arrival in Savannah.

zh.s: 1864年11月30日，美国内战期间，萨凡纳战役的第三场战斗——蜜糖山之战爆发。威廉·T·谢尔曼少将率领的主力部队当时正从亚特兰大向佐治亚州萨凡纳进军，因此没有参加战斗。约翰·P·哈奇准将率领的联邦军远征部队试图切断查尔斯顿—萨凡纳铁路，支援谢尔曼计划抵达萨凡纳，但行动失败。

en.s: The 1869 Texas gubernatorial election was held to elect the governor of Texas. Incumbent Governor Elisha M. Pease, who had been appointed by military governor Philip Sheridan, did not run for re-election. Edmund J. Davis narrowly defeated former Governor Andrew J. Hamilton. en.s: The Winter War (Finnish: Talvisota, Swedish: Vinterkriget, Russian: Зи́мняя война́, tr. Zimnyaya voyna) was a military conflict between the Soviet Union and Finland in 1939–1940. It began with the Soviet invasion of Finland on 30 November 1939 (three months after the outbreak of World War II), and ended with the Moscow Peace Treaty on 13 March 1940. The League of Nations deemed the attack illegal and expelled the Soviet Union from the League on 14 December 1939. The Soviet Union ostensibly sought to claim parts of Finnish territory, demanding—amongst other concessions—that Finland cede substantial border territories in exchange for land elsewhere, claiming security reasons, primarily the protection of Leningrad, which was only 32 km (20 mi) from the Finnish border.

zh.s: 冬季战争是1939至1940年苏联与芬兰之间的战争。1939年11月30日，苏联入侵芬兰，战争爆发；1940年3月13日，双方签署《莫斯科和平条约》，战争结束。国际联盟认定苏联的攻击非法，并于1939年12月14日将苏联驱逐出联盟。苏联声称为安全起见，要求芬兰割让大片边境领土，再以其他地区交换，主要理由是保护距芬兰边境仅32公里的列宁格勒。

en.s: On November 30, 1941, German SS and police units and Latvian auxiliaries began shooting Jews from the Riga ghetto in the Rumbula Forest in occupied Latvia. The mass killings continued on December 8–9. At least 25,000 Jews from the ghetto were murdered across those days, not on November 30 alone.
en.n: November 30 marks the first day; the at least 25,000 figure covers November 30 and December 8–9 together.

en.t: The civil-war phase in Mandatory Palestine is dated from November 30
en.s: November 30, 1947, is commonly used as the beginning of the civil-war phase in British Mandatory Palestine. Violence between Arab and Jewish communities escalated after the United Nations voted for partition on November 29, and attacks on Jewish buses took place on November 30. The conflict continued into May 1948; the UN vote itself occurred the previous day.
en.n: November 30 is a conventional start date for this phase, not the date of the UN partition vote; the motives behind individual attacks are disputed.

en.t: Barbados becomes independent from the United Kingdom
en.s: Barbados became an independent state on November 30, 1966, when its Independence Order and new constitution came into force. It remained a Commonwealth realm, with Elizabeth II as its head of state. Barbados became a republic decades later, in 2021.
en.n: This records independence in 1966, not the transition to a republic in 2021.

zh.t: 巴巴多斯脱离英国独立
zh.s: 1966年11月30日，巴巴多斯独立令和新宪法生效，巴巴多斯成为独立国家。独立后它仍是英联邦王国，英国女王伊丽莎白二世担任国家元首。巴巴多斯直到2021年才改为共和国。
zh.n: 此条记录1966年独立；2021年改为共和国是另一件事。

en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in Singapore on 30 November 1967. This was the first presidential election held in Singapore since the country's independence in 1965. Under the constitution at the time, the president was elected by parliament. Prime minister Lee Kuan Yew nominated incumbent president Yusof Ishak for the presidency, which was met with unanimous agreement by parliament. He was sworn in on 4 December.

zh.s: 1967年11月30日，新加坡举行间接总统选举，这是新加坡1965年独立后首次总统选举。根据当时宪法，总统由国会选出。总理李光耀提名现任总统尤索夫·伊萨克，国会一致同意其连任。他于12月4日宣誓就职。

en.t: South Yemen gains independence from the United Kingdom
en.s: On November 30, 1967, Britain transferred sovereignty over Aden and South Arabia, and the People's Republic of Southern Yemen became independent. The new state occupied territory in what is now southern Yemen. It later united with North Yemen in 1990.
en.n: This records South Yemen's independence, not its later admission to the United Nations or the 1990 Yemeni unification.

zh.s: 1967年11月30日，英国向亚丁及南阿拉伯地区移交主权，南也门人民共和国宣告独立。这个国家位于今天也门的南部地区，后来于1990年与北也门统一。
zh.n: 此条记录南也门独立；加入联合国及1990年南北统一均在之后。

en.s: The withdrawal from Aden was the final withdrawal of British troops from the colony of Aden, 128 years and 10 months after the Aden Expedition first brought the territory under British control. High Commissioner Sir Humphrey Trevelyan boarded an RAF aircraft at RAF Khormaksar after a short handover ceremony on 30 November 1967. The last troops to leave were the Royal Engineers.

zh.s: 英国军队从亚丁殖民地撤出，结束了英国长达128年零10个月的统治。1967年11月30日，最高专员汉弗莱·特里维廉爵士在短暂的交接仪式后，从科尔马卡萨皇家空军基地登上飞机离开。最后撤离的是皇家工兵部队。

en.t: The Pakistan Peoples Party is founded in Lahore
en.s: On November 30, 1967, a group of political activists and left-wing leaders founded the Pakistan Peoples Party at a meeting in Lahore. Zulfikar Ali Bhutto became its first chairman. The founding convention continued into December 1.
en.n: November 30 marks the start of the party's founding convention, which continued the next day.

zh.t: 巴基斯坦人民党在拉合尔成立
zh.s: 1967年11月30日，一批政治活动人士和左翼人士在拉合尔开会，成立巴基斯坦人民党。佐勒菲卡尔·阿里·布托出任首任主席。建党大会持续到12月1日。
zh.n: 11月30日是建党大会首日，大会第二天仍在继续。

en.t: Pro-Soviet communists in the Philippines establish Malayang Pagkakaisa ng Kabataan Pilipino as its new youth wing
en.s: Malayang Pagkakaisa ng Kabataang Pilipino (Tagalog, "Free Union of Filipino Youth"), abbreviated MPKP was a youth organization in the Philippines. It was the youth and student wing of the pro-Soviet Partido Komunista ng Pilipinas-1930 (PKP). The MPKP was founded on November 30, 1967, as the PKP broke its links with the Kabataang Makabayan ("Patriotic Youth").

zh.t: 亲苏共青团组织在菲律宾成立
zh.s: 亲苏联的菲律宾共产党（1930）与爱国青年组织断绝关系后，于1967年11月30日成立马来亚青少年团结组织（MPKP）。该组织是菲律宾共产党（1930）的青年和学生组织。

en.s: The 1977 South African general election was held on 30 November 1977. The National Party, led by John Vorster won a landslide victory in the House of Assembly. The newly formed Progressive Federal Party, led by Colin Eglin became the official opposition. The New Republic Party, successor to the United Party, won only 10 seats, all but one of them in Natal Province. Once again, the Herstigte Nasionale Party failed to win any seats. In the 1977 elections the National Party got its best-ever result in the elections with support of 64.8% of the white voters and 134 seats in parliament out of 165.

zh.s: 1977年11月30日举行南非大选。约翰·福斯特领导的国民党在众议院大胜。新成立的进步联邦党由科林·埃格林领导，成为官方反对党。统一党继承者新共和国党只赢得10席，其中9席来自纳塔尔省。重建国民党再次未能赢得任何席位。国民党在本次选举中取得有史以来最佳成绩，获得白人选民64.8%的支持，在165个议席中赢得134席。

en.s: General elections were held in Palau on 30 November 1984 to elect a President, Vice-President, Senate and House of Delegates. All candidates ran as independents. Incumbent Haruo Remeliik won the election for President with 50.9% of the vote, whilst Alfonso Oiterong was re-elected to the post of Vice-President. Voter turnout was 83.9%.

en.s: W.A.K.O. European Championships 1986 were the eighth European kickboxing championships hosted by the W.A.K.O. organization arranged by Simon Zahopoulos. The championships were open to amateur men and women based in Europe with each country only allowed one competitor per weight division. The styles on offer were Full-Contact (men only) and Semi-Contact kickboxing. West Germany were easily the strongest nation overall by the end of the championships, with hosts Greece in second and Great Britain third in the medals table. The event was held in Athens, Greece on Saturday, November 29 to Sunday, November 30, 1986.

en.s: A regional election was held in the Basque Country on 30 November 1986 to elect the 3rd Parliament of the autonomous community. All 75 seats in the Parliament were up for election. The Socialist Party of the Basque Country (PSE–PSOE) won 19 seats, the Basque Nationalist Party (EAJ/PNV) came second with 17 seats, People's Unity (HB) and Basque Solidarity (EA), a PNV split, each won 13 seats, and Basque Country Left won 9 seats.

The MPS troops entered Chad by crossing the Sudanese border three weeks earlier.

en.s: The 1991 FIFA Women's World Cup final was an association football match that took place on 30 November 1991 at Tianhe Stadium in Guangzhou, China. It was played between Norway and the United States to determine the winner of the 1991 FIFA Women's World Cup. The United States beat Norway 2–1, with two goals from Michelle Akers-Stahl, to become winners of the first ever FIFA Women's World Cup.

en.s: Elections to the Mizoram Legislative Assembly were held in November 1993 to elect members of the 40 constituencies in Mizoram, India. The Indian National Congress won the most seats and formed a coalition with Mizo Janata Dal, whose MLAs contested as independent candidates. The leader of Indian National Congress in Mizoram, Lal Thanhawla was appointed as the Chief Minister of Mizoram for the third time.

zh.t: 1993年米佐拉姆邦立法议会选举
zh.s: 1993年11月，印度米佐拉姆邦举行立法议会选举，选出40个选区的议员。印度国大党赢得最多席位，并与米佐民族人民党组成联盟；后者候选人以独立身份参选。国大党米佐拉姆邦领导人拉尔·坦哈夫拉第三次出任首席部长。

en.s: The 1998 Quebec general election was held on November 30, 1998, to elect members of the National Assembly of the Province of Quebec, Canada. The incumbent Parti Québécois, led by Premier Lucien Bouchard, won re-election, defeating the Quebec Liberal Party, led by Jean Charest. To date this is the last election where the Parti Québécois won a majority of seats in the Quebec Assembly and received over 40% of the vote, although not the last in which it formed a government.

en.s: Lion Air Flight 538 (JT538/LNI538) was a scheduled domestic passenger flight from Jakarta to Surabaya, with a stopover at Surakarta, all in Indonesia. en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Romania on 30 November 2008. The Democratic Liberal Party (PDL) won three more seats than PSD in the Chamber of Deputies and the Senate, although the alliance headed by the Social Democratic Party (PSD) won more votes and a fractionally higher vote share. en.t: Georgia holds runoff elections after its 2010 general election
en.s: The US state of Georgia held general election runoffs on November 30, 2010, after its main election on November 2. en.s: The 2011 Fa Yuen street fire (Chinese: 2011年花園街排檔大火) occurred in Fa Yuen Street, Mongkok, Hong Kong on 30 November 2011 in one of the most densely populated area. The fire killed 9 people and injured 34 others, making it the deadliest fire in Hong Kong in 14 years. It had taken place around the same time as the Hong Kong Fire Services Department's 48-hour protest.

en.s: A by-election was held in the New Zealand electorate of Christchurch East on 30 November 2013. The seat was vacated following the resignation of Lianne Dalziel of the Labour Party from parliament, who contested and won the Christchurch mayoralty in October 2013. The electorate is regarded as a safe Labour seat; the party has, apart from the 50-year gap when the electorate was abolished, held the electorate since the 1922 election, although significant population changes since the 2011 Christchurch earthquake had made this allegiance to Labour less certain. Prior to the election, National's top party official in Canterbury had conceded that the by-election was "very, very hard for [National] to win".

en.s: The 2023–24 Bhutanese National Assembly election was held in two rounds on 30 November 2023 and 9 January 2024 to elect the 47 members of the National Assembly, the lower house of the Parliament of Bhutan. It was the fourth National Assembly election held under Bhutan's 2008 Constitution. Four political parties contested the first round, with the People's Democratic Party (PDP) and the Bhutan Tendrel Party (BTP) qualifying for the second round after finishing first and second respectively.

zh.s: 2023—2024年不丹国民议会选举分两轮举行，日期分别为2023年11月30日和2024年1月9日，选出国民议会（不丹议会下院）47名议员。这是不丹2008年宪法实施后的第四次国民议会选举。首轮有4个政党参选，人民民主党和不丹腾德雷党分别排名第一和第二，进入第二轮。

en.s: The 2023 Telangana Legislative Assembly election was held on 30 November 2023 to elect all 119 members of Telangana Legislative Assembly for its third term. The votes were counted and the results were declared on 3 December 2023. The Indian National Congress (INC) along with its ally Communist Party of India (CPI) won a majority with 65 seats against the incumbent Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS)'s 39 seats.

en.s: On 30 November 2023, clashes broke out in Bissau, the capital of Guinea-Bissau, between government forces and units of the National Guard who had released two ministers accused of corruption from detention. The clashes led to the arrest of National Guard commander Colonel Victor Tchongo. President Umaro Sissoco Embaló described the events as an attempted coup. Following the clashes, Embaló ordered the dissolution of the country's legislature.

zh.s: 2023年11月30日，几内亚比绍首都比绍爆发冲突。政府军与国民警卫队部队交火；后者此前释放了两名因涉嫌腐败被拘留的部长。冲突后，国民警卫队指挥官维克托·琼戈上校被捕。总统乌马罗·西索科·恩巴洛称这是一次未遂政变，并在冲突后下令解散国民议会。

en.s: A by-election was held in the provincial riding of Kitchener Centre in Ontario on November 30, 2023, to elect a new member of the Legislative Assembly of Ontario following the resignation of NDP MPP Laura Mae Lindo. Kitchener City Councillor Aislinn Clancy gained the seat for the Ontario Greens. Clancy is the second member of the Ontario Greens to be elected in the province, following party leader Mike Schreiner.

zh.s: 2023年11月30日，加拿大安大略省基奇纳中心选区举行省级补选，以选出安大略省议会新议员。新民主党议员劳拉·梅·林多辞职后，该席位空出。基奇纳市议员艾斯琳·克兰西为安大略绿党赢得该席位。她是该省第二位当选的安大略绿党议员，首位是党魁迈克·施赖纳。

en.t: Turkish–Syrian National Army offensive in Northern Syria (2024–2025)
en.s: The Turkish–Syrian National Army offensive in Northern Syria (2024–2025) refers to a series of military operations launched by Turkey and the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) against the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) amid the fall of the Assad regime. As part of the 2024 opposition offensives, the SDF captured territory held by the Assad regime including in and around Aleppo. Amidst these gains, on 30 November 2024 the SNA announced Operation Dawn of Freedom, aiming to expand Turkish-controlled territory, weaken the SDF, prevent Kurdish autonomy in post-Assad Syria, and align with Turkish initiatives to establish a 30-kilometer deep buffer zone in the north of the country.

zh.t: 2024—2025年土耳其—叙利亚国民军在叙利亚北部的攻势
zh.s: 2024—2025年土耳其及其支持的叙利亚国民军（SNA）在叙利亚北部发动了一系列军事行动，目标是由库尔德人领导的叙利亚民主力量（SDF），发生在阿萨德政权垮台期间。2024年反对派攻势期间，SDF从阿萨德政权手中夺取了包括阿勒颇及周边地区在内的领土。2024年11月30日，SNA宣布发动“自由黎明行动”，旨在扩大土耳其控制区、削弱SDF、阻止后阿萨德时期库尔德人自治，并配合土耳其在叙利亚北部建立纵深30公里缓冲区的计划。

en.s: The 2024 Survivor Series: WarGames was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by the American promotion WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw and SmackDown. en.s: General elections were held in Honduras on 30 November 2025. Voters elected the President, all 128 members of the National Congress, and 20 representatives to the Central American Parliament (PARLACEN). The National Electoral Council (CNE) declared National Party candidate Nasry Asfura as the election's winner on 24 December. en.s: Doc NYC (stylized as DOC NYC) is an annual documentary film festival in New York City. Co-founded by Thom Powers and Raphaela Neihausen, the festival is the country's largest documentary film festival with over 300 films and events and 250 special guests. By 2014, DOC NYC had become America's largest documentary film festival and voted by MovieMaker magazine as one of the "top five coolest documentary film festivals in the world".
